active_family: state-aware deployable reliability protocol on learned conditional law
current_bottleneck: The frontier model has conditional center skill but its dispersion is not reliably aligned with observable risk state: high history movement and vov states have lower coverage while history_abs_move_q90 strongly predicts realized future jumps.
last_result_summary: 550a audited split geometry and history-only causal-state features on 392a/340c. Mean 90% coverage was 0.867, median MAE was 0.0259 versus 0.0423 for an unconditional median proxy, and MAE reduction was 38.2%. The official validation block has only about 14.7 non-overlap-equivalent 30-day paths, so jump/level gates are brittle but informative.
next_step_recommendation: Run a minimal state-aware reliability experiment that keeps the generative backbone fixed and uses predeclared history-only strata such as history_abs_move_q90, history_vov, and last_mean to penalize undercoverage/path-jump support failures in high-risk states. Report base model metrics separately from calibrated-system metrics.
current_best_note: Both score 8/11 and fail coverage, regime_coverage, and distributional_fidelity. 510a improves coverage geometry and path KS but keeps level KS 10/25 and regime layer2 0/8 while thinning conditionality/cointegration margins.
oracle_feasibility_note: 435a reaches 11/11 only as a validation-future oracle upper bound; it is not a deployable or learned conditional scenario generator.
